text:
Aria (Community): Quick announcement — we just cut redwood-connector-kit v0.3.0 and we're running a Community Integrations Showcase next Wed (6pm PT). RSVP link and short rundown below. Please share with maintainers & contributors. :party:

Leo (Engineering): Nice! what's in v0.3.0? any breaking changes?

Aria (Community): No breaking changes. Main highlights: new auth adapters, smaller bundle sizes, and built-in retry logic for flaky providers. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-connector-kit/releases/tag/v0.3.0

Priya (Maintainer): Want a short blurb to include in README & package changelog. Can you paste the top-level bullets here?

Aria (Community): Sure — pasted below for copy/paste:

```
redwood-connector-kit v0.3.0
- new: OAuth + API-key adapters for common providers
- perf: tree-shaking reduced bundle by ~22%
- fix: retry/backoff for transient 429s
- docs: quickstart for Dedicated + Private deployments
```

Marta (Docs): I'll add the quickstart and a migration note. Priya — do you want me to open the PR against the repo?

Priya (Maintainer): Yes please. If you can include a tiny snippet for Dedicated config that'd be awesome.

Marta (Docs): Will do. Snippet I'll include:

```yaml
# example dedicated config
model: "redwood/opt-3.7b"
replicas: 2
batching: true
cache: prefix
```

Jamal (DevRel): I'll schedule a short tweet + forum post when we have a hero screenshot. Also setting up a short demo track during the Showcase — 3 slots for community maintainers. Priya, want one?

Priya (Maintainer): I can demo the new OAuth adapter. Slot appreciated.

Aria (Community): Awesome. RSVP + demo signups here: https://events.redwood.ai/integrations-showcase (RSVP required for demo slot). We also have a maintainer office hour Tue 10am PT to help with release notes & sample demos.

release-bot: Automated release notice: redwood-connector-kit v0.3.0 published by @aria. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-connector-kit/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0. CI: all checks passed. :robot_face:

Leo (Engineering): Quick reminder — if your demo hits the Dedicated flow, please include a short perf snapshot (p95 latency, tokens/sec). Ops can help with screenshots.

Jamal (DevRel): Copy. I'll add a template in the event doc.

Aria (Community): Thanks team! If anyone needs help prepping demos or publishing a tiny release note, drop into the office hour or ping me directly. :sparkles:
